requirements.summary: A bounded three-peer soak gate runs through the real multiplayer lobby and audit scenario engine
requirements.expected: The built candidate runs host plus two guests in headless installed Chrome for three minutes on the permitted QA ports, with a hard browser-run timeout below four minutes.
requirements.falsifier: The gate uses fewer than three peers, a headed or bundled browser, an unbounded browser process, a port outside 4227-4229, or a play duration below three minutes.

evidence.note: The runner has an explicit three-peer schedule, permitted ports, and a 235-second hard-stop path that kills only its owned browser trees.
The real candidate soak receipt is required before publication; this entry is not owner preview approval.

requirements.summary: Deterministic 120 ms RTT and 1% loss impairment is applied to both multiplayer lanes
requirements.expected: Local QA pages apply 60 ms one-way delay and seeded 1% pre-send loss to state and event traffic, with trace counters recording impairment and drops.
requirements.falsifier: The loss or delay is nondeterministic, applies only to events, is active outside the loopback QA fence, or is absent from the evidence trace.

The real run table is the release evidence and is reported honestly, including any failed finding.
